profile.headline: Senior Software Development Engineer
profile.summary: At Athena Health, my role as a Senior Software Development Engineer involves spearheading significant feature developments, applying Java Best practice principles, and enhancing product functionality with robust APIs. Our collaborative efforts have successfully met intricate business requirements.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer with a track record of leading Agile teams and delivering impactful results.  Collaborated on the development of automotive dealership management and digital retailing solutions.

Key Contributions:

* Led development of value-added features using Java and Angular.
* Designed and deployed APIs with Spring Boot and Node.js.
* Implemented CI/CD pipeline (Jenkins, SonarQube) for improved efficiency.
* Enhanced UI/UX with Angular.
* Utilized Liquibase for database version control and GitHub for code management.
* Improved code reliability through unit testing and defect resolution.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Backend Developer specializing in Java and Node.js for fleet and maintenance management solutions.

* Developed high-performance, secure backend services (Java, Spring, Hibernate).
* Implemented Spring Security for robust access control.
* Built scalable APIs with Node.js, Express, AWS Lambda, and API Gateway.
* Translated business requirements into actionable development items.
* Led project planning and execution with a team of 3 developers.
* Rapidly learned new technologies including NodeJS, Angular, and Python.
